text:
alex nguyen: Quick question — proposing a 'soft holdback' rollout guard that pauses traffic to canary if cost-per-tenant exceeds 50k tokens/min or latency SLO breaches 500ms p95 for 2m. Thinking the Console shows a live "why paused" reason + a single-click override. Thoughts?

marina cruz: Do we want token budget per-tenant or per-route? per-tenant seems safer for multi-route customers.

samir patel: I think combine per-route + per-tenant. We saw a case where one noisy route ate capacity but tenant-wide budget would have avoided broad impact.

priya rao: From runtime: auto-pause currently only based on error-rate. Adding cost as a guard is doable but we'll need a configured fallback route. What's the fallback? lower-cost quantized variant?

alex nguyen: Yes — fallback to `a30-q4` (quantized). Need hysteresis to avoid flip-flop. Proposed config snippet:
```
{
  "guard_name": "budgeted_holdback_v1",
  "conditions": {
    "tokens_per_min": {"threshold": 50000, "window_secs": 120},
    "p95_latency_ms": {"threshold": 500, "window_secs": 120}
  },
  "actions": [
    {"type": "gradual_reduction", "from_pct": 10, "to_pct": 2, "duration_secs": 60},
    {"type": "reroute", "target": "model:a30-q4"}
  ],
  "hysteresis_secs": 300
}
```

deploy-bot: deploy check: rollout schema v3 validation passed :white_check_mark:

samir patel: Telemetry: we need `guard.trigger_reason` (values: `cost_overage` | `slo_latency`) and `guard.action_taken` (values: `pause` | `reroute` | `throttle` | `gradual_reduction`) + `token_burn_rate` metric.

marina cruz: UX: when paused, Console should surface 3 buttons: `Unpause (manual)`, `Reroute to fallback`, `Contact owner`. Also show estimated cost delta and last 5m avg tokens/user.

priya rao: Edge: reroute to fallback can raise latency for realtime flows. We need SLA-aware routing: prefer reroute only for non-realtime routes. Example rule:
```
if route.meta.realtime == false then allow_reroute else prefer_throttle
```

alex nguyen: Also require audit log entries with rollout_id, guard_name, action, reason, and time window. Who owns emitting audit events? @priya?

priya rao: Runtime team will emit events, product needs to define schema. I'll open a PR with spec.

samir patel: Also add 'throttle' as first line of mitigation (reduce split 10% -> 2%) instead of hard pause. Add `gradual_reduction` action to config.

marina cruz: Sounds good. I'll mock UI states for pause/reroute/throttle and add copy for the "why paused" banner. Will include estimated cost savings and last seen offending prompts.

alex nguyen: Action items: priya -> spec + event schema; samir -> telemetry metric names & alert thresholds; marina -> UI mock by EOD Friday. If no objections we'll land this RFC. :thumbsup:
